type
label: Dial
description: A horizontal garden dial, or a vertical dial for a wall (shown lying on its back, face up)

name: decl
label: Wall declination
description: Wall dial only: how far the wall faces away from due south, west positive (a wall facing south-west: 45 deg). Measure it with a compass and correct for magnetic declination, or from the sun at solar noon

name: timeMode
label: Time shown
description: Clock time of your time zone (the hour lines shifted by the longitude correction; add an hour in summer time), or local solar time (noon along the gnomon)

name: place
label: Place
description: A place from the table sets latitude, longitude and the time zone's meridian; Custom uses the three values below

name: latIn
label: Latitude
description: Custom place: degrees north of the equator

name: zoneIn
label: Time zone meridian
description: Custom place: the meridian of your standard time: 15 deg times the zone's hours from UTC (CET +1 h: 15 deg; GMT: 0; EST -5 h: -75 deg)

name: lonIn
label: Longitude
description: Custom place: degrees east of Greenwich (west negative), within 30 deg of the zone's meridian

name: size
label: Dial size
description: Diameter of the disc, or side of the square wall plate

name: thick
label: Plate thickness
description: Dial and gnomon are cut from the same sheet; the slots follow it

name: through
label: Lines cut through
description: Off: lines, ticks and numerals are engraved (shallow cuts); on: they are cut through the plate (a stencil dial)

name: depth
label: Engraving depth
description: Depth of engraved lines (at most half the plate)

name: numerals
label: Hour numerals
description: Roman numerals beyond the hour lines (left out where the lines are too close for them)

name: clearance
label: Slot clearance
description: Extra width and length of the gnomon's slots: 0 is a press fit, 0.1 to 0.2 mm slides in

title: Sundial for your place
description: A sundial that tells the time where you put it: a horizontal garden dial or a vertical wall dial (also on a wall that does not face due south), for a place picked from the table or your own latitude and longitude. The gnomon's style lies along the Earth's axis, at the latitude angle; the hour lines follow the standard formulas and are shifted by the longitude correction so the dial reads the clock time of your zone (add an hour in summer). Lines, half-hour ticks and Roman numerals are engraved or cut through; the gnomon stands in slots on two tabs. Assertions check the built dial against an independent construction: the style's angle, the gnomon on the substyle and every hour line where the shadow of the polar axis falls. To cut it: File > Export..., DXF or SVG with the face set "Cut sheet" (the set "Engraving" holds the engraved areas); STL or 3MF to print.
